text: the right: Heb. justice | not out of fainted lips: Heb. without lips of deceit
slip not: Heb. be not moved
that savest by thy right hand, them which put their trust in thee, from those that rise up against them: Or, that savest them which trust in thee from these that rise up against thy right hand
that oppress me: Heb. that waste me | deadly enemies: Heb. my enemies against the soul
Like as a lion: Heb. The likeness of him (i. of every one of them) is as a lion that desireth to ravin | lurking: Heb. sitting
disappoint him: Heb. prevent his face | which is thy sword: Or, by thy sword
from men which are thy hand: Or, from men by thine hand | they are full of children: Or, their children are full
